test_to_frame_datetime_tz: test the Index.to_frame() method on a timezone-aware DatetimeIndex and verify the resulting DataFrame
test_to_frame_respects_none_name: test that Index.to_frame(name=None) respects an explicit None column name instead of defaulting to 0
test_to_frame_with_renamed_index: test that a renamed DatetimeIndex passed to to_frame(name=None) preserves the None column name
create_datetime_index_to_frame: create a timezone-aware DatetimeIndex and convert it to a DataFrame using to_frame()
test_assert_frame_equal: test that two DataFrames are equal using tm.assert_frame_equal after calling to_frame()
